newsitem.title: USA: Brandywine Realty prices 4 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Brandywine Realty prices 4 mln shr offering.

text.p: Brandywine Realty Trust said that it has priced its public offering of 4 million common shares at $16.50 per share.
Smith Barney Inc and Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc have acted as managing underwriters for the offering, which is expected to close December 2, 1996, Brandywine said in a statement issued on Tuesday.
The company has also granted to the underwriters an option, exercisable for a period ending on December 26, 1996, to purchase up to 600,000 common shares to cover overallotments, Brandywine said.
All of such shares are being sold by the company, Brandywine said.
The number of shares sold and the price per share reflect consummation of the previously announced one-for-three reverse share split, which was effected on November 25, 1996, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to repay debt and to complete the acquisitions of four office buildings for approximately $23 million, Brandywine said.
